verdict.rationale: dlt (as a data platform/library, not an agent) ships an official MCP server (dlt-mcp on PyPI), documented at dlt-hub/dlt-mcp and part of the dltHub AI Harness for coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex; a runtime probe confirms a full keyless stdio initialize handshake with tools/prompts/resources capabilities. Missing for 10: broader independent (non-vendor) hands-on reports of agent integration beyond the single probe.
